paper.abstract_en: We identify a two-gap complexity structure underlying a holographic obstruction to reaching extremality and to the black-hole-mediated route toward weak cosmic censorship violation. The complexity of formation of extremal AdS black holes diverges logarithmically, while it is finite for every subextremal member of the stationary family. We compute the on-shell Wheeler--DeWitt action of overcharged Reissner--Nordström--AdS in general dimension $D\geq4$. In the minimal prescription, defined by omission of the Maxwell boundary term, the individually divergent Maxwell bulk, on-shell Einstein--Hilbert, and Gibbons--Hawking--York terms cancel exactly. We also evaluate the null--timelike joints and null-boundary counterterms explicitly and show that their combined lower-endpoint contribution vanishes. Adding the Maxwell boundary term produces only a prescription-dependent, regulator-local power-law divergence; no prescription produces a logarithmic divergence, and the corresponding vacuum-subtracted complexity=volume complexity of formation is finite. In the complexity=action and complexity=volume prescriptions, the reverse triangle inequality for complexity distance then implies divergent relative complexity across each adjacent gap. Under a finite-complexity-growth assumption, this gives a conditional obstruction to traversing the stationary path from subextremal black holes through extremality to the superextremal naked-singularity sector.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于复杂度的全息障碍来达到极端性和弱宇宙审查违反，具有深刻的理论洞察和严格的计算。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们识别了一个双间隙复杂度结构，它隐藏在全息障碍背后，该障碍阻碍了达到极端性以及黑洞介导的弱宇宙审查违反路径。极端AdS黑洞的形成复杂度呈对数发散，而稳态族中的每个次极端成员的形成复杂度是有限的。我们计算了一般维度D≥4下过充电的Reissner-Nordström-AdS的壳层Wheeler-DeWitt作用量。在最小规定（省略麦克斯韦边界项）中，单独发散的麦克斯韦体项、壳层爱因斯坦-希尔伯特项和吉本斯-霍金-约克项恰好抵消。我们还显式地评价了零-类光连接点和类光边界逆项，并显示其组合的下端点贡献为零。添加麦克斯韦边界项仅产生一个与规定相关、依赖于正则化器的幂律发散；没有任何规定产生对数发散，并且相应的真空扣除复杂度=体积复杂度是有限的。在复杂度=作用和复杂度=体积规定中，复杂度距离的逆三角不等式意味着每个相邻间隙之间的相对复杂度发散。在有限复杂度增长假设下，这给出了一个条件性障碍，阻止从次极端黑洞穿过极端性到达超极端裸奇点扇区的稳态路径。
